commentary.text: 90+14' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+8' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.
90+6' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Ilias Akhomach will be replaced by Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano).
90+6' A substitution has been made. Pacha is replaced by Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano).
90+5' The linesman points to the corner flag, Betis are going to take it.

90+4' Augusto Batalla was forced into action to thwart Antony (Betis). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
90+3' Rayo Vallecano enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
90' 14 additional min. will be played.
90' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Rayo Vallecano as the referee indicates there was no infringement!

85' Play continues despite the shouts by some Rayo Vallecano players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Juan Martinez interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
85' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Valentin Gomez (Betis), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
84' Nelson Deossa (Betis) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Juan Martinez didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
83' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
80' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
80' Natan (Betis) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
77' Inigo Perez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) replacing Jorge de Frutos.
75' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Alvaro Fidalgo as he is replaced by Nelson Deossa (Betis).

75' The most active player in today's match is definitely Antony (Betis). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!
72' Ilias Akhomach (Rayo Vallecano) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
70' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) will deliver the corner kick.
70' Here is a change. Ricardo Rodriguez is going off and Manuel Pellegrini gives the last tactical orders to Valentin Gomez (Betis).
69' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Aitor Ruibal (Betis) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Angel Ortiz.
68' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
66' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Betis.
63' Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) is lucky to receive a yellow card from the referee because he could easily have been given a red card for his foul.
61' Today's match ends for Pablo Fornals who will be replaced by Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis).
61' Inigo Perez has decided to make a change. Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Gerard Gumbau.
61' Fran Perez comes off the pitch to be replaced by Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano).
59' The ratio of the ball possession is 47:53.
58' The attendance for today's match is 59436.
56' Rayo Vallecano seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
55' The ball is cleared after Aitor Ruibal (Betis) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
52' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) takes the free kick from mid-range, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. What a miskick! The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
52' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Betis players are visibly unhappy with the call.
48' There's a break in play and referee Juan Martinez must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Betis using VAR. This could be interesting!
47' Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Betis in a dangerous position.
46' Great teamplay by Betis as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
46' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Cucho Hernandez (Betis) comes on the pitch for Cedric Bakambu.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Juan Martinez has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Today's referee Juan Martinez rightly decides to book Diego Llorente (Betis) for his harsh tackle.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
42' 1 - 1 Goal! Andrei Ratiu puts a cross into the box and finds Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:1.
41' 46:54 – the ratio of ball possession.
40' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
36' Juan Martinez shows a yellow card to Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
36' Rayo Vallecano control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

35' Antony (Betis) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
33' Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
29' A yellow card for a tackle by Pablo Fornals (Betis). Juan Martinez doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
27' Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) has received a yellow card for his foul.
26' Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) makes a slide tackle, but referee Juan Martinez blows for a foul.
24' The Betis players are exchanging some short passes.
23' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
21' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Rayo Vallecano, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
16' 1 - 0 Goal! Cedric Bakambu (Betis) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top right corner. It's 1:0.
15' Juan Martinez interrupts the game. One of the players from Betis won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
13' Pablo Fornals (Betis) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
11' Pablo Fornals (Betis) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
10' Betis work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
9' The Rayo Vallecano players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
7' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
7' Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is out of play. Betis will have a throw-in.
4' The linesman makes the right call and Rayo Vallecano will have a corner.

2' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.

2' The Betis players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession. The linesman signals a throw-in for Rayo Vallecano.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Rayo Vallecano will take the kick-off.
